legend-susten-austrian-south-styrian-win.slogan: Susten? Austrian South Styrian Wine Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-susten-austrian-south-styrian-win.story: official regional wine route. vineyards, rolling hills, farm inns. 46 km from Ehrenhausen to Soboth, about 50 min of riding. It goes by way of Gamlitz and Leutschach. The highest point is about 800 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Susten? Austrian South Styrian Wine Road
